PCI Gases logo as base64 data URIs — for SINGLE-FILE standalone web apps
(where no separate image file can ship alongside the HTML).

Paste the whole data: string as an <img src="...">. Use the 240w variant unless
the logo renders larger than ~120px wide on screen.

=== pci-gases-logo-white-480w.png  (15 KB raw, 20 KB base64) ===
data:image/png;base64,

=== pci-gases-logo-cobalt-480w.png  (15 KB raw, 20 KB base64) ===
data:image/png;base64,

=== pci-gases-logo-white-240w.png  (6 KB raw, 9 KB base64) ===
data:image/png;base64,

=== pci-gases-logo-cobalt-240w.png  (6 KB raw, 9 KB base64) ===
